notes.title: Muse Dash ver.1.4431415926535… update
notes.notes:
If you didn’t know why we kept calling for giving up treatment, just look at the subject line! ( `д´)

After a whole month of crickets, we’ve returned with [Give Up Treatment Vol.10]!

To celebrate 5 million unit sales, we are going all out on this update! On this day, Muse Dash fans receive a grim reminder. They live in fear of the sick new beats ...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31923494/5a083f7f23fca2b51861aaa82448ea8609e00808.png[/img]

[b]Get 30% off the base game and 10% off the [Just As Planned] DLC pass from May 1st through May  9th. [/b]We also have some surprises in store for you collectors: three brand new illustration drops as you level up. There’s never been a better time to start grinding again, hehehe!

And as always - hidden sheets.  Click through the different options in the difficulty settings for [conflict] a few times and see what happens.ヾ(•ω•`)o

And~ we squashed  many  bugs:
- Fixed the touch registration issue with short hold notes
- Fixed the issue where the end beat of hold notes are triggered early
- Fixed the combo counter error in [DataErr0r]
- Fixed the score calculation issue. We finally did it, folks! We finally fixed this long-lasting issue! 
This bug has been around since release, we’ll have to update all the uploaded records at some point later. Terribly sorry for this!

The bug that we didn’t want to fix :P
- Sleepwalker Rin is unable to achieve gold S in certain tracks

Well, the responsible programmer will be asked to go in the oven to clean as soon as this is fixed (╬▔皿▔)╯

Holidays will only affect how fast I  digest the new content (in a good way ). Make sure to check out [Give Up Treatment Vol.10] when the game is updated!

notes.title: 《Muse Dash》 PC&Switch Release!
notes.notes:
Dear players, long time no see. Finally, our dashing rhythm game Muse Dash has came——only after a programmer-dress-in-female drama, countless bugs fixing mess and many nights without sleeping.     

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31923494/7282ad6ec91bce45cdb8766fcdc7bd2290d0e50f.jpg[/img]

By now, Muse Dash has been released on Nintendo Switch Eshop Japan & Europe followed by Eshop US version (00：00 PDT) and Steam version (00:00 PST), with five languages (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean) included first.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QN_uxjjVGmw

Muse Dash Switch version includes all the DLC packs. All the future packs will be updated for free. Switch version will be 3,240 yen ($29.99) and get a special promotion price as 2,916 yen ($26.99).

Meanwhile DLC for PC version can be purchased separately, with base price $2.99 and DLC Bundle $27.99.Get a -20%off discount special promotion within the first week. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31923494/05072b61bcfde54650c0710b0605b791f9c79551.jpg[/img]

Right, don’t forget Marija The Girl In Black will show in Switch and PC version. She is more capable of beating enemies and dodging, allowing players to enjoy the game in a different way. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31923494/a57a7bcf41b346a6b2bf879b0acd1f6001265a45.jpg[/img]

Also, players can sync their game data on mobile to Steam by linking accounts on both sides through「Setting」->「ACCOUNT」. You are welcome to share you questions at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/774171/discussions/0/1645418261862037680/] our Q&A post.[/url]

At last, join the rank competing event in welcoming the release of PC version. The event will last for 1 month. Please find below showing more details:
 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/774171/discussions/0/1645418344565582769/] 
Steam rank competing event[/url]

Beauties are waiting, hurry up guys!
